profiles.intro: The parts of this desktop the installer sets up. Install and Remove show the installer’s plan here first; Apply runs it in the background, behind one password or fingerprint prompt.
profiles.outside: Installed, but not by the installer: it has no record of it, so it does not remove it.
profiles.coreHint: core is the desktop itself: Remove the desktop, in the guided installer, takes it away.

descriptions.core: Hyprland, Quickshell, GDM with the hyprland-uwsm session, portals, audio, network, fonts, zsh and the codecs (from RPM Fusion on Fedora): the desktop itself.
descriptions.hardware: A laptop, in parts checked where the hardware is found: Intel, sound, camera, fingerprint reader, firmware updates.
descriptions.tablet: A 2-in-1: screen rotation, stylus, sign-in without the fingerprint reader while folded, touchscreen gestures (Hyprgrass).
descriptions.plugins: The Hyprland plugins, one by one: Hyprspace (overview), Hyprglass (liquid glass), HyprCapture (screenshots), with the tools and headers building them needs.
descriptions.apps: Desktop apps, one by one: Zen Browser, 1Password, VS Code, and Loupe, Papers and Showtime for images, PDFs and videos.
descriptions.utils: Command-line tools, one by one: Neovim, gcc, xclip, unrar, FUSE, gh, glab, uv, wev and Tailscale.
descriptions.assistant: The AI Assistant: Super + A, its bar icon and its section here, with the Herdr app and herdr-core in ~/.local, which update themselves.
descriptions.radio: The Radio panel (Super + M): mpv with mpv-mpris, yt-dlp, and Qt Multimedia for its video.
descriptions.gaming: Games, one by one: Steam with the 32-bit drivers games need, its HiDPI launcher, gamescope.
